svg.text: Grounded curriculum review · Registry + RAG + Checks + Rule Scoring · Initial scope: Web Development
Upload & login · Analysis progress · Report with priorities · Evidence viewer (PDF.js, highlighted quotes)
Side-by-side: “Your module says (page, quote)” vs “Source says (link, date)” · Faculty decision + rationale
Auth · POST upload (size/type checks) → create job · GET job status / progress · GET report · POST feedback · Returns cached report if provenance matches
(background job — no AI decides, AI only explains)
Provenance stamp on every report: file hash · registry version · library version · model + prompt version · analysis date → same inputs = same result
PostgreSQL + pgvector (one database) · S3-compatible file storage
YAML files in Git, reviewed via PR
Principle: the AI can only say what the sources prove — code finds, checks and scores the evidence; the AI explains it; the faculty decides.
Not shown: login provider (Clerk / Supabase Auth or backend sessions), Docker Compose for local dev, hosting (Vultr Compute instance, Docker Compose + Caddy).
